source: Card names, printed rules texts, types and Influence costs were transcribed 1:1 from imperial-assault.fandom.com (the fan wiki is named as transcription medium only, per wiki_data/LICENSE_DATA.md Punkt 5; the printed ability texts stay build content so the player knows what the card does). Set membership is authoritative on the wiki Agenda Set pages (RR: each Agenda set consists of three cards). Each field was cross-checked against a VLM transcription of the native card scans on imperial-assault.com/Agenda_Decks (see raw/agenda_cards/vision/ for the per-card cache incl. image sha256); disagreements keep the wiki value and raise needs_review. 'time_period' is a vision-only field: it is read off the printed scan and null when no time period is printed. Honest scope: the 30 scan images in the Agenda_Decks inventory that have no wiki card page (expansion / Villain-Pack strays) are NOT in this corpus; the corpus is the 42 complete 3-card Agenda sets documented on the wiki (126 cards).

conventions.ids: card = <set_slug>__<card_slug>, set = slug(set name); slugs lowercase ascii, non-alnum->'_'
conventions.tokens: house token set per tactical_imperial_decks.json: {H} damage {B} surge {C} strain {D} threat {A} action {U} upgrade {O} ranged {P} melee {G} block {F} evade; dice colors as words ('1 blue die'); Strength/Tech/Insight tests as words
conventions.wiki_token_map: wiki template -> house: {{D}}->{H} {{Z}}->{B} {{S}}->{C} {{H}}->{D} {{A}}->{A} {{P}}->{O} {{L}}->{P} {{O}}->{G} {{V}}/{{X}}->{F} (wiki V='evade', X='dodge' icons); {{F}}->'Strength' {{C}}->'Tech' {{I}}->'Insight' test words; {{B}}/{{R}}/{{G}}/{{Y}}/{{W}}/{{K}} -> 'blue|red|green|yellow|white|black defense die'
conventions.time_period: null = none printed (RR: card then legal in every campaign); [lo,hi] ints as printed; a single printed number N is stored as [N,N]; sourced from the vision transcription only
conventions.cost: printed Influence purchase cost (RR 'Agenda Cards'); resolution-time extra costs stay inside 'text', machine-parsed into resolution_cost only via the documented regexes below
conventions.resolution_cost: regexes applied verbatim to the converted text: r'spend (\d+) threat' -> threat; r'spend (\d+) Force tokens?' (also bare 'spend (\d+) Force') -> force; null if neither matches; never inferred from icons
